title: IOE Lớp 4 - Chuyên đề 3 - Vòng Quận/Huyện

part_A.question: Whose book are you reading? – It’s … .
part_A.explanation: "Whose book...? – It's Mary's." – "Whose" hỏi của ai; trả lời dùng sở hữu cách (Mary's).

part_A.question: My father likes coffee, but my mother ....
part_A.explanation: "My father likes coffee, but my mother doesn't." – "but" nối ý đối lập; "doesn't" thay cho "doesn't like coffee".

part_A.question: A: What food do you like? - B: …
part_A.explanation: "What food do you like? – Chicken." – Hỏi thức ăn yêu thích; trả lời bằng tên món ăn.

part_A.question: What … now? – She’s sleeping.
part_A.explanation: "What is Lucy doing now?" – Hiện tại tiếp diễn: What + is + chủ ngữ + doing?

part_A.question: I go to school five days a week, … Monday … Friday.
part_A.explanation: "from Monday to Friday" – "from – to" = từ … đến …; 5 ngày đến trường.

part_A.question: Do you have Maths, Music and Art today? - ___.
part_A.explanation: "Do you have Maths, Music and Art today? – Yes, I do." – Trả lời câu hỏi Yes/No với "do".

part_A.question: Kate is my ___. He is the son of my brother.
part_A.explanation: "Kate is my nephew." – "nephew" = cháu trai (con của anh/chị/em); "He" xác nhận giới tính nam.

part_A.question: There are 12 … in the classroom.
part_A.explanation: "There are 12 students in the classroom." – "students" = học sinh (số nhiều).

part_A.question: She is a ... girl with blue eyes and blond hair.
part_A.explanation: "a beautiful girl" – "beautiful" = xinh đẹp; mô tả ngoại hình con gái.

part_A.question: Elisa is ... something on her book.
part_A.explanation: "Elisa is writing something" – Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is + V-ing; "write" = viết.

part_A.question: Mary can ... both Japanese and Chinese.
part_A.explanation: "Mary can speak both Japanese and Chinese." – "speak" đi sau "can" (không thêm -s).

part_A.question: What can you ___, Nam? – I can swim and play football.
part_A.explanation: "What can you do, Nam? – I can swim and play football." – "do" sau "can you" hỏi khả năng.

part_A.question: What is your ... drink? – I like orange juice the most.
part_A.explanation: "What is your favourite drink? – I like orange juice the most." – "favourite drink" = đồ uống yêu thích.

part_A.question: My sister is a/an ___. She works in the hospital.
part_A.explanation: "My sister is a nurse. She works in the hospital." – "nurse" = y tá; làm việc ở bệnh viện.

part_A.question: I have an English lesson on … .
part_A.explanation: "I have an English lesson on Tuesday." – "on Tuesday" = vào thứ Ba.

part_A.question: Is your classroom big? - No, it isn’t. It’s … .
part_A.explanation: "Is your classroom big? – No, it isn't. It's small." – Câu trả lời phủ định + đưa ra thông tin đúng.

part_A.question: Would you like … coffee? – No, thanks.
part_A.explanation: "Would you like some coffee?" – "Would you like some...?" = Bạn có muốn một ít... không?

part_A.question: ... does Mr. Minh travel to work every day? – By car.
part_A.explanation: "How does Mr. Minh travel to work?" – "How" hỏi phương tiện đi lại; trả lời "By car."

part_A.question: What is his nationality? – He is ….
part_A.explanation: "What is his nationality? – He is Russian." – "nationality" = quốc tịch; "Russian" = người Nga.

part_A.question: Where does ___ work? – She works in a factory.
part_A.explanation: "Where does your sister work?" – "Where does...?" hỏi nơi làm việc (ngôi 3 số ít).

part_A.question: Kathy ___ to music yesterday evening.
part_A.explanation: "Kathy listened to music yesterday evening." – Quá khứ đơn: "listen" → "listened".

part_A.question: My brother and I … my grandpa twice a month.
part_A.explanation: "My brother and I visit my grandpa twice a month." – Chủ ngữ số nhiều + "visit" (không thêm -s).

part_A.question: Can your sister play badminton, Hoa? - ___
part_A.explanation: "Can your sister play badminton? – Yes, she can." – Trả lời câu hỏi "Can" với ngôi 3 số ít.

part_A.question: Can you play badminton, Huong? - ___.
part_A.explanation: "Can you play badminton? – No, I can't." – Trả lời phủ định câu hỏi "Can".

part_A.question: What is … hobby? – She likes … with dolls.
part_A.explanation: "What is her hobby? – She likes playing with dolls." – "her hobby" và "playing with dolls".

part_A.question: What does Jane look like? ...
options: A. She has Maths on Tuesday.
D. She is looking at her house.
part_A.explanation: "What does Jane look like? – She's tall and slim." – "look like" hỏi ngoại hình; trả lời mô tả.

part_A.question: Kim: What kind of … do you like? - Hoa: I like cartoons.
part_A.explanation: "What kind of films do you like? – I like cartoons." – "kind of films" = thể loại phim.

part_A.question: Mary is from America. She can speak ... .
part_A.explanation: "Mary is from America. She can speak American." – Người Mỹ nói tiếng Anh Mỹ (American English).

part_A.question: During ... lessons, I learn to sing songs.
part_A.explanation: "During Music lessons, I learn to sing songs." – "during" = trong suốt; "Music lessons" = giờ Âm nhạc.

part_A.question: Peter is a _______ at London Primary School.
part_A.explanation: "Peter is a pupil at London Primary School." – "pupil" = học sinh tiểu học.

part_A.question: What is your favourite ...? - It's Art.
part_A.explanation: "What is your favourite subject? – It's Art." – "favourite subject" = môn học yêu thích.

part_A.question: She is writing a letter … her friend.
part_A.explanation: "She is writing a letter to her friend." – "write a letter to somebody" = viết thư cho ai đó.

part_A.question: Listen! The girl ... the piano.
part_A.explanation: "Listen! The girl is listening to the piano." – Hiện tại tiếp diễn; "listen to" = nghe.

part_A.question: When is your brother’s birthday? - … .
part_A.explanation: "When is your brother's birthday? – It's in July." – "When" hỏi thời điểm sinh nhật.

part_A.question: What toys do you have? – I have three ______ and one ______.
part_A.explanation: "I have three teddy bears and one train." – Liệt kê đồ chơi; "teddy bears" + "train".

part_A.question: Mary has PE on Monday and Friday. She has it … .
part_A.explanation: "Mary has PE on Monday and Friday. She has it twice a week." – "twice a week" = 2 lần/tuần.

part_A.question: A: What class is Linda in? - B: …
options: C. She wasn’t at school today.
D. She’s having a Maths lesson.
part_A.explanation: "What class is Linda in? – She's in class 4D." – Hỏi lớp học; trả lời "in class 4D".

part_A.question: A: What’s the … tomorrow? - B: It’s the fifteenth of August.
part_A.explanation: "What's the date tomorrow? – It's the fifteenth of August." – Hỏi ngày mai là ngày mấy.

part_A.question: What is Jane’s favourite …? – It’s basketball.
part_A.explanation: "What is Jane's favourite sport? – It's basketball." – "sport" = môn thể thao.

part_A.question: ___ does An have on Fridays? – She has English.
part_A.explanation: "What does An have on Fridays? – She has English." – "What" hỏi môn học; "on Fridays" = vào thứ Sáu.

part_A.question: Is … a holiday? – No, it isn’t.
part_A.explanation: "Is Birthday a holiday? – No, it isn't." – "holiday" = ngày lễ; sinh nhật không phải ngày lễ.

part_A.question: They _______ happily at the party last weekend.
part_A.explanation: "They sang happily at the party last weekend." – Quá khứ đơn: "sing" → "sang".

part_A.question: … does your father work? – He works … a big company.
part_A.explanation: "Where does your father work? – He works in a big company." – "where" hỏi nơi làm việc.

part_A.question: Hai … with us to the cinema next Sunday.
part_A.explanation: "Hai won't go with us to the cinema next Sunday." – "won't" = will not; tương lai phủ định.

part_A.question: I like meat very much. ... .
part_A.explanation: "I like meat very much. It's my favourite food." – Dùng "It's" thay cho "Meat is" ở câu tiếp theo.

part_A.question: Lan had a cough and she was very ti_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "ti_red_" → "tired" = mệt mỏi; điền "red". Có ho và cảm thấy mệt.

part_A.question: My brother s_ _ dies at Quang Trung Primary School.
part_A.explanation: "s_tu_dies" → "studies" = học tập; điền "tu". Anh trai học tại trường tiểu học Quang Trung.

part_A.question: Hoa is mak_ _ _ a paper plane.
part_A.explanation: "mak_ing_" → "making" = đang làm; điền "ing". Hoa đang gấp máy bay giấy.

part_A.question: I can hear with my _ _ _ s.
part_A.explanation: "_ear_s" → "ears" = đôi tai; điền "ear". "I can hear with my ears."

part_A.question: Jane never goes to bed l_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "l_ate_" → "late" = muộn; điền "ate". Jane không bao giờ đi ngủ muộn.

part_A.question: I w_ _ _ to school every morning.
part_A.explanation: "_alk_" → "walk" = đi bộ; điền "alk". "I walk to school every morning."

part_A.question: My brother is ten ye_ _ _ old.
part_A.explanation: "ye_ars_" → "years" = tuổi (năm); điền "ars". "ten years old" = 10 tuổi.

part_A.question: Bye, Hoa. _ _ _ you on tomorrow afternoon.
part_A.explanation: "_See_" → "See" = gặp lại; điền "See". "See you tomorrow" = Hẹn gặp lại ngày mai.

part_A.question: “Tom and Jerry” is my favouri_ _ cartoon.
part_A.explanation: "favouri_te_" → "favourite" = yêu thích; điền "te". "Tom and Jerry is my favourite cartoon."

part_A.question: Don’t cl_ _ _ a tree again.
part_A.explanation: "cl_imb_" → "climb" = leo trèo; điền "imb". "Don't climb a tree again."

part_A.question: Hue is in _ _ _ tral Viet Nam.
part_A.explanation: "_cen_tral" → "central" = miền trung; điền "cen". Huế ở miền Trung Việt Nam.

part_A.question: What’s its n_ _ e? - It’s Quang Trung School.
part_A.explanation: "n_am_e" → "name" = tên; điền "am". "What's its name? – It's Quang Trung School."

part_A.question: Viet Nam is a count_ _ in the Southeast Asia.
part_A.explanation: "count_ry_" → "country" = đất nước; điền "ry". "Viet Nam is a country."

part_A.question: Where are you from, John? – I’m from Amer_ _ a.
part_A.explanation: "Amer_ic_a" → "America" = nước Mỹ; điền "ic".

part_A.question: My b_ _ room is small but it’s beautiful.
part_A.explanation: "b_ed_room" → "bedroom" = phòng ngủ; điền "ed".

part_A.question: His birthday is on the f_ _ st of August.
part_A.explanation: "f_ir_st" → "first" = thứ nhất (số thứ tự); điền "ir". "the first of August" = ngày 1 tháng 8.

part_A.question: The past form of DRAW is _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "_drew_" → "drew" = quá khứ của "draw" (vẽ); điền "drew".

part_A.question: This is the way Mai go_ _ to school every day.
part_A.explanation: "go_es_" → "goes" = đi (ngôi 3 số ít); điền "es". "Mai goes to school every day."

part_A.question: My classr_ _ m is not big.
part_A.explanation: "classr_oo_m" → "classroom" = phòng học; điền "oo".

part_A.question: What a pity! I can’t _ _ _ a computer.
part_A.explanation: "_use_" → "use" = sử dụng; điền "use". "I can't use a computer."

part_A.question: Your father’s sister is your _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "_aunt_" → "aunt" = cô/dì/bác gái; điền "aunt". Chị gái của bố là cô/bác của bạn.

part_A.question: Is the superm_ _ _ et near here?
part_A.explanation: "superm_ark_et" → "supermarket" = siêu thị; điền "ark".

part_A.question: Some b_ _ _ s can fly but they can’t swim.
part_A.explanation: "b_ird_s" → "birds" = những con chim; điền "ird". Chim bay được nhưng không bơi được.

part_A.question: Mi _ _ _ Ngoc can’t play tennis.
part_A.explanation: Lưu ý: câu này có vẻ bị lỗi nguồn; "Mi and Ngoc can't play tennis" → có thể là "Mi and Ngoc".

part_A.question: Milk is my favourite d_ _ _ k.
part_A.explanation: "d_rin_k" → "drink" = đồ uống; điền "rin". "Milk is my favourite drink."

part_A.question: Her sister is twelve years o_ _ .
part_A.explanation: "o_ld_" → "old" = tuổi; điền "ld". "twelve years old" = 12 tuổi.

part_A.question: My sister is a student at Hoang Mai Primary Sch_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "Sch_ool_" → "School" = trường học; điền "ool". Trường tiểu học Hoàng Mai.

part_A.question: It’s the twenti_ _ _ of December.
part_A.explanation: "twenti_eth_" → "twentieth" = thứ hai mươi (số thứ tự); điền "eth".

part_A.question: My mother does gymnast_ _ _ every morning.
part_A.explanation: "gymnast_ics_" → "gymnastics" = thể dục; điền "ics". "does gymnastics" = tập thể dục.

part_A.question: My sister likes to e_ _ pizzas.
part_A.explanation: "e_at_" → "eat" = ăn; điền "at". "My sister likes to eat pizzas."

part_A.question: My noteboo_ _ are on the desk.
part_A.explanation: "noteboo_ks_" → "notebooks" = các quyển vở; điền "ks" (số nhiều).

part_A.question: Mary has got IT, M_ _ ic, PE and Maths today.
part_A.explanation: "M_us_ic" → "Music" = Âm nhạc; điền "us". "Mary has got Music today."

part_A.question: Andy stay_ _ home all day yesterday.
part_A.explanation: "stay_ed_" → "stayed" = ở lại; điền "ed" (quá khứ đơn). "Andy stayed home all day."

part_A.question: My crayons a_ _ on the table.
part_A.explanation: "a_re_" → "are" = (to be số nhiều); điền "re". "My crayons are on the table."

part_A.question: My sister go_ _ to bed at 10.45 p.m.
part_A.explanation: "go_es_" → "goes" = đi/đến (ngôi 3 số ít); điền "es". "My sister goes to bed at 10.45."

part_A.question: I want to buy some _ _ _ sents for my baby sister.
part_A.explanation: "_pre_sents" → "presents" = quà tặng; điền "pre". "some presents for my baby sister."

part_A.question: Today is Sunday. L_ t’s go to the cinema.
part_A.explanation: "L_e_t's" → "Let's" = Let us (hãy cùng); điền "e". "Let's go to the cinema."

part_A.question: Jane can’t fly _ _ _ she can’t ride a horse.
part_A.explanation: "_and_" → "and" = và; điền "and". "Jane can't fly and she can't ride a horse."

part_A.question: Is he your uncle? – No, he _ _ _ ’t.
part_A.explanation: "isn_'t_" → "isn't" = is not (phủ định); điền "n". "No, he isn't." (xác nhận phủ định).

part_A.question: The students are sp_ _ king English.
part_A.explanation: "sp_ea_king" → "speaking" = đang nói; điền "ea". "The students are speaking English."

part_A.question: Do_ _ your grandfather like going fishing?
part_A.explanation: "Do_es_" → "Does" = trợ động từ ngôi 3 số ít; điền "es". "Does your grandfather like...?"

part_A.question: Let’s go to the playg_ _ _ nd.
part_A.explanation: "playg_rou_nd" → "playground" = sân chơi; điền "rou". "Let's go to the playground."

part_A.question: They are Kor_ _ _ . They are from Korea.
part_A.explanation: "Kor_ean_" → "Korean" = người Hàn Quốc; điền "ean". "They are Korean. They are from Korea."

part_A.question: Hung comes from Ho Chi Minh C_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "C_ity_" → "City" = thành phố; điền "ity". "Ho Chi Minh City."

part_A.question: The cat is lying _ _ _ er the bed.
part_A.explanation: "_und_er" → "under" = ở dưới; điền "und". "The cat is lying under the bed."

part_A.question: There is only _ _ _ girl in my class.
part_A.explanation: "_one_" → "one" = một; điền "one". "There is only one girl in my class."

part_A.question: Our school looks a bit s_ _ _ l.
part_A.explanation: "s_mal_l" → "small" = nhỏ; điền "mal". "Our school looks a bit small."

part_A.question: The _ _ _ of my father is my brother.
part_A.explanation: "_son_" → "son" = con trai; điền "son". "The son of my father" = con trai của bố tôi.

part_A.question: My school is in Da Lat c_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "c_ity_" → "city" = thành phố; điền "ity". "Da Lat city."

part_A.question: I don’t like rock _ _ _ ic much.
part_A.explanation: "_mus_ic" → "music" = âm nhạc; điền "mus". "I don't like rock music much."

part_A.question: My mother isn’t _ _ _ . She is thin.
part_A.explanation: "_fat_" → "fat" = béo; điền "fat". Mẹ không béo, mẹ gầy (thin).

part_A.question: What do you like doing, Phong? – I like w_ _ ching TV.
part_A.explanation: "w_at_ching" → "watching" = đang xem; điền "at". "I like watching TV."

part_A.question: Today is Tuesday. Do you ha_ _ Music today? – Yes, I do.
part_A.explanation: "ha_ve_" → "have" = có/học; điền "ve". "Do you have Music today?"

part_A.question: Don’t _ _ _ _ in this river again, Tom.
part_A.explanation: "_swim_" → "swim" = bơi; điền "swim". "Don't swim in this river again."

part_A.question: We _ _ _ _ a bus to school every day.
part_A.explanation: "_take_" → "take" = bắt (xe); điền "take". "We take a bus to school."

part_A.question: I often do my home_ _ _ _ after school.
part_A.explanation: "home_work_" → "homework" = bài tập về nhà; điền "work". "do my homework."

part_A.question: I have _ _ _ _ er at 6 p.m.
part_A.explanation: "_dinn_er" → "dinner" = bữa tối; điền "dinn". "I have dinner at 6 p.m."

part_A.question: Comple_ _ the sentences.
part_A.explanation: "Comple_te_" → "Complete" = hoàn thành, điền vào; điền "te". "Complete the sentences."

part_A.question: It’s _ _ _ _ to go to bed, John.
part_A.explanation: "_time_" → "time" = giờ, lúc; điền "time". "It's time to go to bed."

part_A.question: Friday is the fifth day of the _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "_week_" → "week" = tuần; điền "week". "Friday is the fifth day of the week."

part_A.question: Andy is not strong. He is w_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "w_eak_" → "weak" = yếu đuối; điền "eak". Đối lập với "strong" = mạnh.

part_A.question: I had a birthday party _ _ st Monday.
part_A.explanation: "_la_st" → "last" = trước; điền "la". "last Monday" = thứ Hai tuần trước.

part_A.question: I ha_ _ three rulers on that desk.
part_A.explanation: "ha_ve_" → "have" = có; điền "ve". "I have three rulers."

part_A.question: Mai is w_ _ _ ing a dictation now.
part_A.explanation: "w_rit_ing" → "writing" = đang viết; điền "rit". "Mai is writing a dictation now."

part_A.question: How are you t_ _ _ _ ?
part_A.explanation: "t_oday_" → "today" = hôm nay; điền "oday". "How are you today?"

part_A.question: My / drawing / aunt / likes / too. /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "My aunt likes drawing too." – like + V-ing; "too" = cũng (ở cuối câu).

part_A.question: boats. / paper / like / I / making /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "I like making paper boats." – like + V-ing; "paper boats" = thuyền giấy.

part_A.question: have / We / Music / Tuesdays. / on /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "We have Music on Tuesdays." – "on Tuesdays" = vào các thứ Ba.

part_A.question: little / is / a / cat. / It /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "It is a little cat." – "a little cat" = một chú mèo nhỏ.

part_A.question: very / early. / breakfast / I / have /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "I have breakfast very early." – "have breakfast" = ăn sáng; "very early" = rất sớm.

part_A.question: two / flat / has / My / bedrooms. /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "My flat has two bedrooms." – "flat" = căn hộ; "two bedrooms" = hai phòng ngủ.

part_A.question: breakfast? / When / you / do / have /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "When do you have breakfast?" – When + do + chủ ngữ + V?

part_A.question: swimming / Mary / with / me. / likes /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Mary likes swimming with me." – like + V-ing; "with me" = cùng tôi.

part_A.question: very / schoolyard / The / is / large. /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "The schoolyard is very large." – Chủ ngữ + is + very + tính từ.

part_A.question: trees? / Does / like / Huy / planting /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Does Huy like planting trees?" – Does + chủ ngữ + like + V-ing?

part_A.question: my / notebooks. / not / are / These /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "These are not my notebooks." – These + are not + tính từ sở hữu + danh từ.

part_A.question: after / computer / games / dinner. / Let’s play /
part_A.answer: Let’s play computer games after dinner.
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Let's play computer games after dinner." – "Let's + V"; "after dinner" = sau bữa tối.

part_A.question: in the morning? / Does / your mother / like / doing yoga /
part_A.answer: Does your mother like doing yoga in the morning?
